# gfe-unitary-fork

> Computation code (Python: numpy, scipy, sympy, mpmath) for the preprint "A Ghost-Free, Unitary, Starobinsky-Class Realization of Gravity from Entropy" by Cristian Ruvalcaba and the Saluca Agentic AI Research Team. MIT licence; the preprint is CC-BY-4.0 on Zenodo (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21361405).

This is a research archive, not a library: every file in continuum/ is a standalone script, run from the repo root with no arguments, that prints its result. Failed attempts are kept on purpose. The critical spectrum was obtained with the Ohta-Percacci-Vacca parametrization (opv_*.py), not with the earlier fR_*.py solvers; the README's original "not obtained" status is superseded (see its dated correction). The RG trajectory to the fork's exact IR ratios remains undecided.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/README.md): status and correction, install, quickstart, per-script timings
- [continuum/README.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/continuum/README.md): per-script guide with dated outcomes of every attempt

## Code

- [continuum/opv_spectrum.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/continuum/opv_spectrum.py): critical exponents around OPV Solution 1 (4.000, 2.021)
- [continuum/opv_sol3.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/continuum/opv_sol3.py): OPV Solution 3 residual and spectrum
- [continuum/opv_verify.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/continuum/opv_verify.py): checks the exact quadratic fixed point satisfies the flow equation
- [continuum/fR_fixedpoint.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/continuum/fR_fixedpoint.py): Dietz-Morris f(R) fixed point in polynomial truncation (slow, over 5 minutes)
- [continuum/fork_embedding.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/continuum/fork_embedding.py): where the fork's f(R) sits in RG theory space
- [continuum/cheb.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/continuum/cheb.py): Chebyshev differentiation instrument imported by the spectral solvers
- [continuum/opv_traj_conv.py](https://github.com/saluca-labs/gfe-unitary-fork/blob/master/continuum/opv_traj_conv.py): truncation convergence study of the trajectory test
